# TinyMDE vendor files

MDWiki vendors the browser-ready TinyMDE `v0.2.28` release so the application does not require Node.js, npm, a CDN, or a JavaScript build step.

- Project: https://github.com/jefago/tiny-markdown-editor
- Release: https://github.com/jefago/tiny-markdown-editor/releases/tag/v0.2.28
- Release archive SHA-256: `1662075bb60f081ba1b7394eaa8f86592bce912adb18f612096d2f58bd5396a9`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The committed runtime files are `tiny-mde.min.js` and `tiny-mde.min.css` from the official release archive.
